answer_1.quote: We present the task of background news summarization that complements each update in a timeline with a background summary...
answer_1.outputs: background summaries for each timeline update

answer_2.quote: We report scores on the standard summarization metric ROUGE, two factuality metrics QuestEval, and BERTScore ... and our proposed utility metric BUS.

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-3.5 to generate (background) questions from the update text ... and re‑prompt the model to extract answers from the background text ... BUS measures the percentage of questions answerable by the background.

answer_4.quote: We use the Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) platform... We collect judgments from three annotators about which of the three displayed summaries is the best (i.e., most helpful) and which one is the worst (i.e., least helpful).
answer_4.guideline: Best‑worst scaling (BWS) where annotators choose the most helpful and least helpful summary; instructions included criteria such as comprehensiveness and usefulness.
